script_text: Pisces, the cosmic tide drags your sensitive water sign into a week where true illusion meets reality. Late week, Sun in your 5th trines Pluto in your 9th Friday, fueling creativity, while weekend Moon in your 12th invites quiet watery retreat. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Neptune, harmonizing heart and wallet. Monday is your worst day because Mercury square Uranus scrambles routines. Review joint accounts before Thursday’s opposition to stay financially secure. Follow for daily updates.
